response.overview: The relegation of Saudi Arabia's Al-Ahli FC to the First Division (Yelo League) during the 2021-2022 season was one of the most shocking and tragic turning points in Saudi and Arab football history, given the club's prestigious status as one of Jeddah's giants and a traditional powerhouse.
response.tagline: The Fall and Rise of Al-Ahli
response.title: هبوط النادي الأهلي السعودي
